name: prosperity_music_d1
description: Comprehensive Canonical Cloudflare D1 Database Schema for Prosperity Music

indexes: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_profiles_username ON profiles(username);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_songs_user_id ON songs(user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_songs_song_id ON songs(song_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_songs_liked_at ON songs(liked_at DESC);

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_songs_liked_at AFTER INSERT ON songs FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.liked_at IS NULL OR NEW.liked_at = 0 BEGIN UPDATE songs SET liked_at = (strftime('%s', 'now') * 1000) WHERE id = NEW.id; END;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_albums_user_id ON albums(user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_albums_album_id ON albums(album_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_albums_added_at ON albums(added_at DESC);

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_albums_added_at AFTER INSERT ON albums FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.added_at IS NULL OR NEW.added_at = 0 BEGIN UPDATE albums SET added_at = (strftime('%s', 'now') * 1000) WHERE id = NEW.id; END;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_playlists_user_id ON playlists(user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_playlists_owner_id ON playlists(owner_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_playlists_type ON playlists(type);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_playlists_updated_at ON playlists(updated_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_playlists_created_at ON playlists(created_at DESC);

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_playlists_created_at AFTER INSERT ON playlists FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.created_at IS NULL OR NEW.created_at = 0 BEGIN UPDATE playlists SET created_at = (strftime('%s', 'now') * 1000), updated_at = (strftime('%s', 'now') * 1000) WHERE id = NEW.id; END;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_playlist_tracks_playlist_id ON playlist_tracks(playlist_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_playlist_tracks_song_id ON playlist_tracks(song_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_listening_history_user_id ON listening_history(user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_listening_history_played_at ON listening_history(played_at DESC);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_listening_history_user_song ON listening_history(user_id, song_id);

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_listening_history_played_at AFTER INSERT ON listening_history FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.played_at IS NULL OR NEW.played_at = 0 BEGIN UPDATE listening_history SET played_at = (strftime('%s', 'now') * 1000) WHERE id = NEW.id; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_listening_history_played_at_upd AFTER UPDATE OF song_id ON listening_history FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.played_at IS NULL OR NEW.played_at = 0 BEGIN UPDATE listening_history SET played_at = (strftime('%s', 'now') * 1000) WHERE id = NEW.id; END;
